perplexity.description:
Attack Of The Grey Lantern Live At The Ritz" by Paul Draper is a live album capturing the full performance of Mansun's seminal debut album, originally released in 1997. Recorded at The Ritz in Manchester on March 1, 2018, this album revisits the rock and pop sound that defined the original, blending intricate songwriting with energetic live instrumentation. Draper’s delivery and the band's dynamic execution emphasize the album’s layered textures and melodic complexity, highlighting its enduring appeal in the alternative rock scene.

This live recording holds a significant place in Draper's discography as it commemorates the 25th anniversary of "Attack Of The Grey Lantern," showcasing his evolution as a solo artist while honoring his work with Mansun. Released by Kscope in 2019 (vinyl) and later in 2022 (CD), the album received positive attention for its faithful yet vibrant reinterpretation of the classic tracks, appealing both to longtime fans and new listeners. Its reception underscores the album’s lasting influence and Draper’s continued relevance in the rock genre.
